name: Human Activity Recognition Grand Challenge (2005)
description: A benchmark challenge designed to evaluate and compare algorithms for recognizing human activities from video and/or sensor data.
reputation: Historically influential in early HAR research; useful as a reference but largely superseded by larger modern datasets.
notes: Relatively small/outdated datasets and evaluation protocols by modern standards; sensor/video modality differences and label ambiguity can affect comparability; not an LLM benchmark.
